subject: Stakeholder timebox proposal — staggered VP/CIO coverage for CeresCloud demo
body:
From: Tim Lee <timothy.lee@cerescloud.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha.mathews@cerescloud.com, sales_ops@cerescloud.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — CIO/VP attendance question

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the deck. For next week’s 60-minute session we can commit 20 minutes from me (CIO) but the VP of Eng can only join for the final 15 minutes. Would you be able to run a staggered flow where you present the high-level business outcomes first (20–25m), then hand to a short tech deep-dive when the VP joins, and wrap with Q&A?

If that won’t work, we can also consider two shorter blocks on consecutive days.

Regards,
Tim
Tim Lee
CIO, CeresCloud

---
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Tim Lee <timothy.lee@cerescloud.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood demo — CIO/VP attendance question

Tim — thank you, that schedule makes sense and is workable. Suggested approach: 60-minute single session with an intentional "handoff gate" at 25 minutes. Agenda (proposed):

- 00:00–00:05 — quick introductions and objectives (Neha)
- 00:05–00:25 — business outcomes, TCO & reliability story (Neha + Marissa)
- 00:25 — sponsor handoff: clear that VP joins now (calendar notification)
- 00:25–00:45 — technical deep-dive / latency and security (Vivek + Karthik)
- 00:45–00:60 — tailored Q&A and next steps (all)

We’ll emphasize the business asks first so your CIO gets decision context even if the VP arrives late. We’ll also record and add timestamped highlights for the VP if they miss the opening.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can your team confirm that the VP can be on the call no later than +25 minutes so we can time the handoff?
2) Please share any high-priority topics (security, data residency, throughput) to include in the 20-minute deep-dive.

I’ll attach a short mutual action plan and a security checklist for review. If you prefer two shorter blocks instead, we can propose 30m + 30m on consecutive days and split scope.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: CeresCloud_Security_RFI.pdf (pdf)

---
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, Tim Lee <timothy.lee@cerescloud.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — CIO/VP attendance question

Neha — I can own the tech deep-dive. A couple of operational notes that would help optimize the 20m slot:
- We’ll prepare a 7-slide micro-deck focused on latency profiles at 8k token/session, quantization options, and expected cost delta for your production traffic.
- If you can send a sample tail-latency target and a representative prompt pattern (1–2 examples), we’ll tune the demo traces to match.

If the VP is only available for the last 15m we’ll compress the tech content into highlights + 3 priority slides and keep the rest in the recording.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product — Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

---
From: aisha.mathews@cerescloud.com <aisha.mathews@cerescloud.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, Tim Lee <timothy.lee@cerescloud.com>
Cc: sales_ops@cerescloud.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — CIO/VP attendance question

Neha, Vivek — thanks for the clear plan. We like the single-session handoff approach. Confirming: the VP will aim to join by minute 25 but could be delayed up to 10 more minutes. We need the recording and a one-page timestamped summary for our execs.

Also, we’ve uploaded a short security addendum and would like to walk one compliance scenario in the Q&A: RFI item #4 (audit log retention).

A couple logistics items:
- Can you set a calendar event with a 15-minute pre-brief (internal) for your presenters?
- Please include a DocuSign link for the mutual action plan; I’ll get procurement to sign immediately after the demo.

Regards,
Aisha Mathews
Head of Platform, CeresCloud

---
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: aisha.mathews@cerescloud.com, Tim Lee <timothy.lee@cerescloud.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Stakeholder timebox proposal — staggered VP/CIO coverage for CeresCloud demo

Thanks — good signal. Final plan and next steps:
1) Single 60-minute session on Tue 9 Mar 2027, 10:00–11:00 PT (calendar invite to follow). We’ll include a 15-minute private pre-brief for Redwood presenters at 09:45 PT.
2) Agenda will follow the handoff timebox above; Vivek will cover latency and ops, Karthik will be on the call to answer integration/SDK questions.
3) We’ll record and publish a 1-page timestamped summary and attach it to the HubSpot deal record.
4) DocuSign: sending MAP link now — please sign within 48 hours so procurement can proceed.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, CeresCloud_Security_RFI.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/CeresCloud-demo-MAP
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If anything changes on your side (VP can only do two 30m blocks) we can pivot — give me a heads up by EOD Friday and we’ll propose the split schedule.

See you next week —
Neha

--
